---
title: "October 2026: Checking the Detector's Output"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)

flights <- read_csv("data/processed/flights.csv")
loops   <- read_csv("data/processed/loops.csv")
```

## Who is making all these loops?

Classify each loop's callsign: airlines use 3 letters then numbers (ASA416), US private aircraft use N-numbers (N517MS).

```{r}
loops <- loops |>
  mutate(
    callsign = replace_na(callsign, ""),
    operator = case_when(
      str_detect(callsign, "^[A-Z]{3}[0-9]") ~ "airline-style",
      str_detect(callsign, "^N[0-9]")        ~ "private (N-number)",
      callsign == ""                         ~ "no callsign",
      TRUE                                   ~ "other"
    )
  )

loops |> count(is_arrival, operator)
```

## The busiest loopers

If a handful of callsigns make hundreds of loops each, they are training or survey flights, not holds.

```{r}
loops |> count(callsign, operator, sort = TRUE) |> head(15)
```

## How big are the loops?

Airline holds are big (tens of km). Practice laps around a runway are small.

```{r}
ggplot(loops, aes(size_km, fill = operator)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2) +
  labs(x = "Loop size (km)", y = "Number of loops", fill = NULL)
```

## Airline arrivals at SEA: how many were delayed?

```{r}
arrivals <- flights |>
  filter(is_arrival, is_airline)

arrivals |>
  summarise(
    arrivals       = n(),
    with_loop      = sum(n_loops > 0),
    percent        = round(100 * mean(n_loops > 0), 1),
    total_loops    = sum(n_loops)
  )
```

What kind of loops were they, and who flew them? Check that the flight school (RFS) is gone.

```{r}
holds <- loops |>
  filter(is_arrival, is_airline)

holds |> count(type)
holds |> count(callsign, sort = TRUE) |> head(10)
```

Delays by day. Bad-weather days should stand out.

```{r}
daily <- arrivals |>
  mutate(date = as_date(as_datetime(end_time, tz = "America/Los_Angeles"))) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarise(arrivals = n(), delayed = sum(n_loops > 0))

ggplot(daily, aes(date, delayed)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Arrivals with at least one loop",
       title = "Airborne delay at SEA, October 2026")
```

## Can speed and altitude separate airliners from the flight school?

```{r}
holds <- loops |>
  filter(is_arrival, is_airline) |>
  mutate(group = if_else(str_starts(callsign, "RFS"), "RFS fleet", "other airline-style"))

holds |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(
    loops        = n(),
    median_speed = round(median(avg_speed, na.rm = TRUE)),
    median_alt   = round(median(avg_alt, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

ggplot(holds, aes(avg_speed, avg_alt, color = group)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Average ground speed in the loop (m/s)",
       y = "Average altitude in the loop (m)",
       color = NULL)
```
